# NerdsTech

> NerdsTech is a full-stack digital studio that provides AI automation, web design and development, branding, SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) integration, and mobile app development as one team, with zero hand-offs between vendors. NerdsTech is based in Murrysville, Pennsylvania, USA, and works with clients worldwide. Every project gets a fixed quote before work begins. Consultations are free. Replies arrive within 24 hours.

## What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?

AEO is the practice of structuring a website so AI answer engines, such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude, can find, understand, and cite the business in their answers. AEO combines machine-readable site files (llms.txt), structured data (schema markup), AI-crawler access, and answer-first content that states facts clearly enough for an engine to quote. AEO differs from SEO: SEO optimizes for a ranked list of links; AEO optimizes to be the answer itself.

## Process

NerdsTech follows a four-phase process on every engagement:

1. Discover: goals, customers, and bottlenecks mapped.
2. Design: wireframes to polished, on-brand interfaces.
3. Build: clean code, tested across devices.
4. Launch & Grow: ship, measure, and iterate, with SEO and automation compounding.

## Frequently asked questions

- How quickly can we start a project? Most projects kick off within one week of signing. Smaller builds (landing pages, brand refreshes) can start even sooner.
- Do you only work with large companies? Not at all. Roughly half of NerdsTech clients are startups and small businesses. The Launch tier exists so early-stage companies can get agency-quality work without agency-sized budgets.
- Who owns the final code and designs? The client does, 100%. On final payment, all source files, designs, and accounts transfer to the client. No lock-in.
- Will my website actually rank on Google? Every site NerdsTech ships is technically SEO-ready: fast loads, clean structure, proper metadata, and AI-search formatting. Rankings also depend on competition and content over time, and NerdsTech gives a straight answer about your market before you spend anything.
- Do you provide support after launch? Yes. Every project includes a post-launch support window, and most clients move to a monthly care plan covering updates, backups, monitoring, and small improvements.
- Can you take over or fix my existing website? Yes. NerdsTech audits what exists, says what is worth keeping, and rebuilds or repairs only what needs it. About a third of its work starts as rescue projects.

More answers: https://www.nerdstech.co/#faq and on each service page.

## Blog

The blog at https://www.nerdstech.co/blog publishes practical guides on SaaS automation, AI support, onboarding, churn prevention, the automation roadmap, and website security.

- [AI-Secure Websites: How We Build Sites With Multiple Layers of Safety](https://www.nerdstech.co/blog/ai-secure-websites-multiple-layers-safety): A secure website is not one tool or one language. It is multiple independent layers of safety, safe code, data structured for safety, a hardened server, AI as a guard, and process, so if one layer fails, the next one holds. Built in any language, including PHP. Answers: is PHP unsafe after recent vulnerabilities, does AI secure a website automatically, how many layers a small business website needs, and whether an existing website can be made AI-secure.
